# A Taxonomy of Epistemic Failure Modes in Large Language Models

Archival repository for a Hermes Labs Zenodo preprint. Read the paper
at https://hermes-labs.ai/research/taxonomy-of-epistemic-failure-modes or cite the DOI directly.

## What this is

This paper organizes seven observed classes of epistemic failure in language models: Null-Result Asymmetry, Source-Status Credibility Bias, Agency Dissolution, Performative Hedging, Constraint Evasion, Silent Instruction Relaxation, and Controversy-Truth Conflation. It reports a bottom-up synthesis from an author-held research corpus and identifies twelve experiments by corpus identifier in the accompanying registry.

## Evidence boundary

The published PDF is authoritative. The author retains supporting corpus materials; the materials are not represented here as a complete raw corpus or an independently reproducible package. Running verify.py checks package integrity, citation identity, and published PDF bytes; it does not verify the reported 1,461-experiment corpus or establish independent replication.

Not peer reviewed. Deposited on Zenodo, which assigns a DOI without refereeing.
